_note: Water that OSM does not map, drawn into the bake as natural=water areas (tools/bake.ts, after the OSM areas). Rings are lat/lon. The Japanese Tea Garden's ponds are traced from the garden's own map and put into place by an affine fit to its buildings (data/teagarden/map-trace.json, tools/teagarden/ponds.py; control points within 2.4 m), and checked against the lidar ground: each lies in the low ground. OSM has only the Main Pond.

ponds.name: Japanese Tea Garden: drum pond
ponds.note: the drum bridge's pond, east of the Main Pond in the low ground between the tea house terrace and the ridge

ponds.name: Japanese Tea Garden: teahouse pond
ponds.note: the pond below the tea house, south of its terrace

ponds.name: Japanese Tea Garden: sunken pond
ponds.note: the Sunken Garden's pond, north of the gift shop where the ground falls away to the north
